articles.summary: NEW YORK --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 27, 2026-- Colgate-Palmolive (NYSE:CL) Chairman, President and CEO, Noel Wallace, will participate in a fireside chat on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 at 8:15 a.m. ET at the Barclays 2026 Global Consumer Staples Conference.
articles.title: Colgate-Palmolive Webcasts Fireside Chat at the Barclays 2026 Global Consumer Staples Conference
